title: 2.6 Area of a part of a circle

1.title: Question: a slice of a circle

q.Q1: Q1. Find the area of a sector of radius 7 cm and angle 72° (take π = 22/7).
q.Q2: Q2. A circular path 2 m wide surrounds a circular pond of radius 5 m. Find the area of the path (π = 3.142).

q.Q3: Q3. A chord subtends 60° at the centre of a circle of radius 10 cm. Find the area of the minor segment (π = 3.142, sin 60° = 0.8660).

q.Q4: Q4. A wiper blade sweeps through 120°. The blade starts 10 cm from the pivot and ends 45 cm from the pivot. Find the area cleaned (π = 3.142).
q.Q5: Q5. How does the area of a sector change if the radius is doubled but the angle stays the same?

4.title: Explain: common region of two circles

q.Q6: Q6. Two circles of radius 6 cm have centres 6 cm apart. Each chord AB subtends 120° at both centres. Find the area of the common region (π = 3.142, sin 120° = 0.8660).

q.Q7: Q7. The arm can only turn through 300° because of a road. Find the area irrigated in hectares (1 ha = 10 000 m², π = 3.142).

q.Exit ticket: Exit ticket. Write the formula for the area of a sector.
